effects.title: Basic Attack
effects.description: Melakukan hingga 4 serangan berturut-turut, memberikan  Havoc DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack
effects.description:
Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang, memberikan  Havoc DMG.
Jika mengenai target dengan setidaknya 100 Imagination, Roccia melompat ke udara dan mengaktifkan Beyond Imagination Mode.
Semakin lama tombol Basic Attack ditekan, semakin banyak Imagination yang didapat Roccia.
Dalam mode ini, Roccia dapat terus mengisi serangan meskipun STA habis.
Heavy Attack akan otomatis dilepaskan saat tombol Basic Attack dilepas atau saat Imagination mencapai batas maksimal.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack
effects.description: Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan  Havoc DMG.

effects.title: Dodge Counter
effects.description: Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge yang sukses untuk menyerang target, memberikan  Havoc DMG
Roccia memproyeksikan kreativitasnya ke dunia nyata, menarik musuh di sekitarnya dan memberikan  Havoc DMG.
Roccia lalu melompat ke udara dan mengaktifkan Beyond Imagination Mode.
Roccia memulai Commedia Improvviso!, memberikan  Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
Untuk setiap 0.1% Crit. Rate di atas 50%, skill ini meningkatkan ATK semua Resonator di tim sebesar 1 poin selama 30 detik, hingga maksimal 200 po

effects.title: Beyond Imagination Mode
effects.description:
Saat dalam Beyond Imagination Mode dengan setidaknya 100 Imagination, tekan Basic Attack untuk mengonsumsi 100 Imagination dan menggunakan Basic Attack - Real Fantasy.
Beyond Imagination Mode berakhir jika Roccia tidak lagi di udara atau diganti keluar dari field.

effects.title: Basic Attack - Real Fantasy
effects.description:
Melakukan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut, memberikan  Havoc DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
Jika Roccia mendarat setelah Stage 1 atau Stage 2 dengan lebih dari 100 Imagination, dia akan melompat ke udara dan mengaktifkan Beyond Imagination Mode lagi.

effects.title: Imagination
effects.description:
Roccia dapat menampung hingga 300 Imagination.
- Menggunakan Normal Attack mengembalikan Imagination.
- Menahan Normal Attack mengisi daya serangan berikutnya sekaligus mengembalikan Imagination.
- Menggunakan Resonance Skill - Acrobatic Trick mengembalikan 100 Imagination.
- Menggunakan Intro Skill - Pero, Help mengembalikan 100 Imagination.
Menggunakan Resonance Skill atau Heavy Attack meningkatkan ATK Roccia sebesar 20% selama 12 detik.

effects.title: Super Attractive Magic Box
effects.description: Setelah Outro Skill digunakan, kemampuan Utility Resonator berikutnya diganti dengan Magic Box.

effects.title: Magic Box
effects.description:
Saat digunakan, menarik musuh di sekitarnya ke dalam Magic Box, memberikan 100 poin  Havoc DMG.
Skill ini dianggap sebagai Echo Skill yang memberikan Utility DMG.
Magic Box bertahan selama 14 detik atau hingga Resonator diganti keluar.
Menyerang target, memberikan  Havoc DMG.
Gunakan Basic Attack setelah skill ini untuk langsung menggunakan Basic Attack Stage 4.
Resonator yang masuk mendapatkan efek:

effects.title: - Basic Attack DMG meningkat 25%
effects.description: Efek berlangsung 14 detik atau hingga Resonator diganti keluar.
Menggunakan Resonance Skill - Acrobatic Trick memberikan 100 tambahan Imagination dan 10 Concerto Energy.
Basic Attack - Real Fantasy menjadi kebal terhadap interupsi.
Menggunakan Basic Attack - Real Fantasy memberikan  Havoc DMG Bonus 10% kepada seluruh Resonator dalam tim selama 30 detik, dapat menumpuk hingga 3 kali.
Saat mencapai stack maksimum, tim mendapatkan 10% tambahan  Havoc DMG Bonus selama 30 detik.

sequences.name: When The Heart Sees And Hands Feel

effects.description: Menggunakan Intro Skill - Pero, Help meningkatkan Crit. Rate Roccia sebesar 10% dan Crit. DMG sebesar 30% selama 15 detik.

sequences.name: When Wonders Gather In The Box

effects.description: Menggunakan Resonance Skill - Acrobatic Trick meningkatkan Basic Attack - Real Fantasy DMG Multiplier sebesar 60% selama 12 detik.

sequences.name: When Dreams Are Reborn On Stage

effects.description: Resonance Liberation - Commedia Improvviso! mendapatkan 20% tambahan DMG Multiplier.
Heavy Attack mendapatkan tambahan 80% DMG Multiplier.
Menggunakan Resonance Liberation - Commedia Improvviso! memberikan efek berikut selama 12 detik:
- Basic Attack - Real Fantasy mengabaikan 60% DEF musuh.
Setelah melakukan Basic Attack - Real Fantasy Stage 3, Roccia melompat ke udara dan mengaktifkan Beyond Imagination Mode. Dalam mode ini:
- Basic Attack berubah menjadi Basic Attack - Reality Recreation, memberikan DMG setara 100% dari Basic Attack - Real Fantasy Stage 3, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
- Roccia kebal terhadap interupsi saat menggunakan Basic Attack - Reality Recreation.
- Setelah Basic Attack - Reality Recreation selesai, Roccia melompat ke udara lagi, mengaktifkan kembali Beyond Imagination Mode.
- Basic Attack - Reality Recreation hanya tersedia dalam Beyond Imagination Mode.

Info.Title: No Description Available
Info.Content:
Assistant, prop master, and improv comedian, Roccia is always there to make sure the Troupe of Fools is at the ready.

The Magic Box she carries appears to hold the world, or perhaps she had recreated a world inside the box.

TalentDoc.Title: Resonance Evaluation Report
TalentDoc.Content:
[Troupe Medic Benir's Notes - R103]

After watching Roccia on a few occasions and studying her behaviors, it seems like our first mate has a way of communicating with that strange creature, Pero. With Pero acting as a translator, Roccia can even talk to other Echoes. What's interesting is that her ability seems to be growing—at first, she needed to speak with the Echoes, but now it looks like she can communicate through frequencies.

This only started after she joined the troupe and met Pero, so I'm guessing it's some sort of resonance between them, something she picked up along the way. We'd probably call her a Non-congenital Resonator.

P.S. All this is just my best guess, though. With the tools I have, I can't pin down exactly what type she might be. There's a small chance Roccia isn't actually a Resonator, but just so happens to be able to sync up with certain frequencies. Wouldn't that still count as being a Resonator? I'll have to think on it.

TalentCertification.Title: Overclock Diagnostic Report
TalentCertification.Content:
[Troupe Medic Benir's Notes - R103]

During the examination, Roccia chose white clams, seaweed, pink salt, and filtered water to make a pot of clam soup. It turned out nice and clear, with the shells intact. Right when it was done, the clams and seaweed looked a bit like a tiny island—or maybe even a little box.

From the way the soup came together, it's clear Roccia's senses are sharp, her mind is calm, and that she has a strong bond with the troupe. No sign of Overclocking here.

P.S. Roccia had the brilliant idea of replacing the teacup assessment with a soup assessment. After all, soup is more filling, and after the examination, there's enough for everyone to have a meal. It doesn't taste too bad, either.
